headline.purpose: The one title on a screen, such as Вход or Статистика.

title.purpose: Panel and dialog titles in Segoe UI.

body.purpose: Answers, table cells, and help text. 65 to 75 characters.

label.purpose: Buttons, nav, field labels, and chips. Sentence case.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Modal forms and menus only. Tinted with terrace ink.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: State changes on background, border, and color. 160ms. Removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled action: enter, save, navigate. Ink fill, on-ink text. Light theme is a dark stone button. Dark theme flips it.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2e241d; color: #f8f9f5; font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: 0.01em; padding: 12px 18px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 0.7); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #40362e; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2e241d; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #f4f6f0; color: #494139; box-shadow: none; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Fresh Green Button
components.description: Same fresh green as the primary. There is no second filled color.
components.css: .ds-btn-rust { background: #4b764b; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: 0.01em; padding: 12px 18px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-rust:hover { background: #3a653b; } .ds-btn-rust:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4b764b; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-rust { transition: none; } }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Cancel and leave. Surface fill with a gate line.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #fafbfc; color: #222427; font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: 0.01em; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #6e7276; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #e7eaec; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4b764b; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-secondary { transition: none; } }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label above the field. Placeholder uses gate muted so it clears 4.5:1.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #222427; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: 0.01em; } .ds-input { background: #fafbfc; color: #222427; font: 400 1rem/1.5 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #6e7276; border-radius: 8px; transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #44484c; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #4b764b; outline: 2px solid #4b764b; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-input { transition: none; } }

components.name: Side Nav
components.description: Glass rail on the stage. The active link is an ink chip with on-ink text.
components.html: СтатистикаПартнёрыБаза знаний
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 208px; padding: 12px; background: #f3f5f6; border-right: 1px solid #6e7276; font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { color: #44484c; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-decoration: none; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: #e7eaec; color: #222427; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4b764b; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-link-active { background: #e7eaec; color: #3a653b; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav-link { transition: none; } }

components.name: Partner Chip
components.description: A partner type or filter. Selected state is wash plus a green border, not color alone.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip { background: #fafbfc; color: #222427; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid #6e7276; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #e7eaec; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4b764b; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip-selected { background: #e7eaec; color: #3a653b; border-color: #4b764b; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: One job: a form, a table, or a stat. Flat, with a gate line. Dialogs add the ink shadow.
components.html:
Партнёры

Три новых предложения за неделю.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #fafbfc; color: #222427; border: 1px solid #6e7276; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; max-width: 65ch; } .ds-panel-title { font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.35; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin: 0 0 16px; } .ds-panel-body { font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.5; margin: 0; } .ds-panel-dialog { box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgb(34 36 39 / 0.14); }

components.name: Wordmark
components.description: Two gate prongs, then MIKE / BALI GUIDE in temple stone. Once per screen.
components.html: MIKEBALI GUIDE
components.css: .ds-mark { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 2px; margin: 0; color: #2b2e32; background: #f3f5f6; padding: 8px 12px; } .ds-mark-gate { display: block; } .ds-mark-name { font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-mark-role { font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; }

components.name: Share Legend
components.description: Chart series in fixed order, each with a text label. Color is never the only signal.
components.css: .ds-legend { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: #222427; min-width: 220px; } .ds-legend li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-swatch { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 4px; flex: none; } .ds-legend-num { margin-left: auto; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #44484c; }

narrative.overview:
Mike is still the guide at the gate. The interface is the gloss from the Telegram app: a tinted stage, frosted panes, a bright rim, and ink for the one filled action. Light theme is a pale leaf-green stage. Dark theme is a warm night.

The Telegram app puts a day photograph under the light theme and a dusk photograph under the dark theme. The admin and the partner cabinet do not. Their stage is the solid color, so a table stays readable. The CRM cabinet has not moved.

This system rejects the generic slate SaaS dashboard, the luxury Bali resort brochure, the travel-blog cream and sand template, the neon beach-club promo, and the corporate real-estate CRM.
keyCharacteristics: One voice for the Telegram chat, the admin, and the partner cabinet
Two themes, remembered per app, with a sun/moon switch
Solid stage on the cabinets; the photograph stays on the Telegram app
Frosted panes with a 1px edge, an inset sheen, and a soft offset shadow
Ink is the filled action, the focus ring, and the active nav item
Chart green is a series color, never a button
Compact 8px controls and 12px panels; the theme switch is the only cabinet pill

rules.name: The Not-the-Shirt Rule
rules.body: Linen Shirt (#e7cfb5) is the portrait. It is never a page, panel, input, or button fill. Sand, cream, and a green page wash are the same mistake. The page stays stone grey.

rules.name: The Embroidery Budget Rule
rules.body: Fresh green is the only filled action. It marks the current section and the lead count. The wordmark and the page stay stone. Two filled buttons in one row are prohibited. Charts may also use Chart Blue (#397094) and Chart Blossom (#8d5570). Those two colors do not appear on buttons, links, or the page.

rules.name: The One Gate Rule
rules.body: Thread gold is the candi mark and nothing else. No gold type, no gold buttons, no gold rules, no gold chart as the only highlight.

rules.name: The Stitch and Speech Rule
rules.body: Segoe UI carries the wordmark, the page title, and the UI. A display serif on the name is out.

rules.name: The Logo Lockup Rule
rules.body: The only all-caps setting is the wordmark: MIKE, then BALI GUIDE. Section titles, buttons, and nav are sentence case. No tracked uppercase eyebrow above a section.

rules.name: The Straight Stitch Rule
rules.body: A high-contrast fashion serif, a script, or a gold headline is the luxury brochure, and it is out.

rules.name: The Solid Stage Rule
rules.body: Cabinets use the stage color and nothing behind it. The day and dusk photographs belong to the Telegram app. Glass keeps its sheen and its shadow. The border stays visible on the flat stage.

dos: Do set the page to Warung Paper (#f3f5f6) and body text to Terrace Ink (#222427).
Do use Temple Stone (#2b2e32) for the wordmark and page titles.
Do use ink for the filled button, the active nav item, and the focus ring. Chart green stays a series color.
Do keep cabinet panels at 12px with glass, a visible edge, an inset sheen, and an offset shadow. Tables and inputs use the opaque glass.
Do set Segoe UI on the wordmark, page titles, labels, tables, buttons, and body.
Do write button labels as a verb plus an object, in Russian, sentence case: "Сохранить партнёра", "Открыть карту".
Do color chart categories in this order: Fresh Green (#4b764b), Chart Blue (#397094), Chart Blossom (#8d5570), Fresh Green Hover (#3a653b), Chart Blue Deep (#215271). Other stays Gate Muted.
Do pair every chart color with a text legend.
Do remove color and shadow transitions when `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` is set.
donts: Don't build the generic slate SaaS dashboard. No blue-gray slate palette, no gray-on-gray tables, no second display face on the title.
Don't drift into a luxury Bali resort brochure: gold serif, infinity pool, barefoot-luxury copy. Thread gold is the 28px gate mark only.
Don't use the travel-blog cream and sand template. Linen Shirt (#e7cfb5) is never a background.
Don't use a neon beach-club / nightlife promo: no cyan, magenta, or purple chart series.
Don't look like a corporate real-estate CRM: no dense gray grids, no tiny uppercase headers, no side-stripe alerts.
Don't put two filled buttons in one row, or use rust, gold, or a second green for text or fills.
Don't carry meaning by color alone. Errors need a sentence. Charts need a legend. Selected chips need a state.
Don't animate layout, bounce, or reveal content by hiding it until a class is added.
